advisories.reason: Dev-only: reached only through ESLint's Next.js plugin. No patched braces release exists (3.0.3 is the latest), and npm's suggested fix downgrades eslint-config-next to 14.x, which is incompatible with Next.js 16.
advisories.mitigation: Not shipped in the production bundle (npm audit --omit=dev is clean). braces only expands glob patterns from repository-controlled ESLint configuration, never user input.
